objective: Inspect the running application in desktop/mobile browsers and fix observed usability, functional and release-readiness gaps
acceptance_criteria: Document browser findings across public, merchant and admin pages and complete relevant fixes
Storefront/cart/checkout are keyboard accessible and respect stock and server pricing
Merchant catalog and order documents expose product option information needed to fulfill orders
Navigation/forms/errors work across tested mobile and desktop routes
Existing tenant, inventory, promotion and checkout-recovery protections are preserved
Release checks and affected browser regressions pass on the updated local stack
non_goals: External deployment or new payment/courier accounts
